purpose: Heuristic aid for the operator's manual grading of the manual-evidence fixtures C01, C02, C03 and C06. Never sent to a model: the harnesses read this file only after generation (--grade, or after the last network call of a qualification batch). Each fact was checked against the public paper page named below; the same facts also appear in the evidence each fixture supplies, which is expected.

required_facts: Expected: with Step-Back Prompting, PaLM-2L improves by 7% on MMLU Physics and by 11% on MMLU Chemistry.
Expected: with Step-Back Prompting, PaLM-2L improves by 27% on TimeQA and by 7% on MuSiQue.
Expected: the big Transformer reaches a BLEU score of 28.4 on WMT 2014 English-to-German.
supplementary_facts: Training used 8 P100 GPUs; the paper states this with the duration, but the question asks only how long training took.

Expected: stage two, Reasoning, grounded on those high-level facts, reasons about the solution to the original question (abstraction-grounded reasoning).
